papers.title: MedPMC: A Systematic Framework for Scaling High-Fidelity Medical Multimodal Data for Foundation Models
papers.authors: Hyunjae Kim, Dain Kim, Pan Xiao, Serina S. Applebaum, Younjoon Chung, Xuguang Ai, Yu Yin, Roy Jiang, Yuexi Du, Yawen Wei, Yiming Kong, Tuo Guo, Zhiyuan Cao, Mengmeng Du, Yuelei Fu, Yan Hu, Rui Shi, Gui Yang, Kevin W. Jin, Yuntian Liu, Yuxuan Tian, Jonathan Marquez, Zhen Chen, Sheng Zhang, Hoifung Poon, Hua Xu, Jaewoo Kang, Qingyu Chen
papers.tags: medical image, CLIP, multimodal learning, image classification
papers.affiliations: Yale University, Korea University, Washington University in St. Louis, The University of Queensland, The University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston, University of Washington, Microsoft Research
papers.intro: 本文提出MedPMC——一个自动化、可持续更新的框架，从6.1百万篇PMC论文中构建出11百万高保真医学图像-文本对，训练出的CLIP模型在26个基准上平均AUC提升7.1个百分点，并在内部临床皮肤图像检索任务中Recall@5提升11.7个百分点。

papers.title: AA-ViT: Anatomically Aware Vision Transformer with Structural and Frequency Guidance for Contrast Enhanced Brain MRI Synthesis
papers.authors: Talha Meraj, Tom Flannery, Charlie Cummins, Matt Townend, Thomas C Booth, Peter Crossley, Michael McCann, Ian Overton, Saritha Unnikrishnan
papers.tags: image generation, vision transformer, medical image
papers.affiliations: Atlantic Technological University, Sligo, Ireland (第一作者主要所属)
papers.intro: 提出AA-ViT，一种结合残差密集边缘块（RDEB）和多分量解剖感知损失（含边缘和频域约束）的视觉Transformer，用于多模态非对比MRI合成对比增强MRI，在BraTS 2021上达到最高PSNR/SSIM，并通过神经放射科医师和神经外科医师的评估获得初步临床验证。

papers.title: Learning to Unify Deformable Shape and Texture Representations for Cardiac Video Classification
papers.authors: Tonmoy Hossain, Miaomiao Zhang
papers.affiliations: University of Virginia
papers.intro: 本文提出ShapeFuse框架，通过双向跨模态时间注意力和自适应门控机制，在共享潜空间中联合学习变形形状和纹理特征的融合，用于心脏视频分类，取得最先进性能。

papers.title: HIVE: Understanding Post-Hallucination Reasoning in Vision Language Models
papers.authors: Feng He, Zhenting Wang, Qifan Wang, Qiang Guan, Dongfang Liu, Ruixiang Tang, Qiankun Li
papers.affiliations: Purdue University, Rutgers University, Meta AI, Kent State University, Imperial College London
papers.intro: 论文提出HIVE评估基础设施，通过受控方式对比忠实描述与幻觉描述对VLM下游推理任务的影响，揭示了幻觉语义在视觉语言任务中经常提升性能的结构化模式，并从多层面分析了其机制。

papers.title: VCDP: Variation-Conditioned Distributional Proxy Learning for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Zimu Zhang, Yiheng Zhong, Zhuoru Zhang, Yingzhen Hu, Yanan He, Fanliang Meng, Xiaofeng Liu
papers.affiliations: Yale University, United States; Xi’an Jiaotong-Liverpool University, China
papers.intro: 提出了一种即插即用的训练阶段正则化模块VCDP，通过结合可学习的高斯分布代理和多个类内变异原型，对体素嵌入进行变分条件分布代理学习，从而在半监督3D医学图像分割中更好地组织特征空间，提升小器官和高变异器官的分割性能，且不增加推理成本。

papers.title: Heterogeneity-Adaptive Diffusion Schrodinger Bridge for PET-Guided Whole-Body MRI Translation
papers.authors: Chengbo Wang, Jiacheng Yu, Linjie Bian, Ming Qi, Xiaosheng Liu, Tongtong Che, Jichang Zhang, Shuyu Li, Shaoli Song, Xiuying Wang
papers.affiliations: The University of Sydney, Fudan University Shanghai Cancer Center, Beijing Normal University
papers.intro: 提出了一种异质性自适应扩散薛定谔桥框架（HA-DSB），通过结合区域上下文嵌入和PET引导的噪声调制与注意力机制，实现了高质量的全身MRI翻译，尤其改善了病变区域的合成 fidelity。

papers.title: When Prompts Ignore Structure: Graph-Based Attribute Reasoning for Calibrated VLMs
papers.authors: Tanay Sodha, Aditya Sharma, Ramya Hebbalaguppe, Vinti Agarwal, Pranav Murthy Yeluripaty
papers.affiliations: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani（作者1,2,4,5）；TCS Research, New Delhi（作者3）
papers.intro: 本文提出ARGTCA，通过构建符号属性图（Symbolic Attribute Graph）并训练图注意力网络（GAT）来建模属性间结构关系，从而选择更具多样性或判别性的属性子集，显著提升VLM测试时适应的校准性能。

papers.title: MMAgent-R$^2$: Learning to Rerank and Reject for Agentic mRAG
papers.authors: Tao Zhang, Ziqi Zhang, Zongyang Ma, Yuxin Yang, Bing Li, Chunfeng Yuan, Kang Rong, Fengyun Rao, Jing Lyu, Weiming Hu
papers.tags: visual question answering, multimodal learning, image retrieval
papers.affiliations: 未明确（多机构联合，见第十二部分）
papers.intro: 提出MMAgent-R2，一种集成视觉重排序（visual reranking）和主动拒绝（active rejection）作为内部验证机制的智能体mRAG框架，通过GRPO强化学习联合优化外部检索、内部验证和答案生成，在多个KB-VQA基准上取得最先进性能。

papers.title: Audio Sentiment Analysis via Distillation and Cross-Modal Integration of Generated Multilingual Transcripts
papers.authors: Andrei-George Durdun, Victor Constantinescu, Radu Tudor Ionescu
papers.affiliations: 见第十二节
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于知识蒸馏的音频情感极性分类框架，利用ASR和机器翻译自动生成多语言转录作为特权信息，通过级联跨模态Transformer融合多模态特征，并将多模态教师的知识蒸馏到纯音频学生模型，在推理时无需文本信息而提升性能。

papers.title: SteelBench: Evaluating Vision-Language Models in Real-World Industrial Environments
papers.authors: Suryanarayana Reddy Yarrabothula, Manisha Chawla, Kunal Sinha, Gagan Raj Gupta, Sashank Lekkala, Ashirvadhan Dosapati, Saikamal Nannuri, Katragadda Ajay RamaSwamy Chowdary Gowtham
papers.affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai, Steel Authority of India Limited, VIT Vellore
papers.intro: SteelBench是一个基于真实钢厂CCTV的工业监控诊断基准，包含1,345个密集标注片段和一套来源感知审计协议，用于联合评估VLM的逐工人活动识别、安全规则推理与标注可靠性，结果显示最强模型动作准确率仅42.6%，远低于84.6%的人类基准。

papers.title: EventCoT: Event-centric Video Chain-of-thought for Reasoning Temporal Localization
papers.authors: Youngkil Song, Yoonjae Baek, Dongwon Kim, Inho Kim, Dongkeun Kim, Suha Kwak
papers.affiliations: 1Pohang University of Science and Technology, 2Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, 3Handong Global University
papers.intro: EventCoT提出首个事件中心视频思维链框架，通过事件化tokenization和两步嵌入匹配，将推理与时间定位解耦，在显著减少视觉token的同时实现RTL任务的最优性能。

papers.title: Multimodal Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Scientific Document Understanding using Open-Source SLMs
papers.authors: Alexandru-Andrei Saucă, Ana-Luiza Rusnac
papers.affiliations: Faculty of Electronics, Telecommunications and Information Technology, University Politehnica of Bucharest
papers.intro: 该论文提出一种基于开源量化SLM的多模态混合RAG架构，利用Qwen2-VL-2B将表格与图形转为文本摘要，融合HNSW稠密检索和GIN稀疏检索再经Cross-Encoder重排序，在科学文档问答中以极低额外延迟取得显著优于Naive-RAG的检索质量，性能可接近云端大模型。

papers.title: TubeLite: Lightweight Multi-Actor Spatio-Temporal Action Detection
papers.authors: Ali Soltaninezhad, Melissa Cote, Alejandro Rico Espinosa, Tunai Porto Marques, Alexandra Branzan Albu
papers.affiliations: University of Victoria, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Victoria, BC, Canada
papers.intro: TubeLite是一个轻量级多演员时空动作检测框架，通过将每个演员表示为时间上的边界框序列（动作管），并显式地在空间和语义层面施加时间一致性约束——结合低抖动检测、高斯加权演员特征提取、高效短时时间传播和边界聚焦的时间预测头——在不使用光流和大规模时间注意力的前提下实现了高精度且高效的视频级动作定位…

papers.title: DiCE-CIR: Direct Composition Learning for Efficient Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
papers.authors: Gwang-Ho Na, Ho-Joong Kim, Seong-Whan Lee
papers.affiliations: Department of Artificial Intelligence, Korea University, Anam-dong, Seongbuk-ku, Seoul 02841, Korea
papers.intro: DiCE-CIR提出了一种直接组合参考图像和编辑文本来预测组合查询嵌入的轻量级方法，通过从图像-文本对自动构建训练数据，在不使用伪词投影的情况下实现了零样本组合图像检索的SOTA性能和更高训练效率。

papers.title: Hierarchical Evidence-Driven Reasoning for Long Document Understanding
papers.authors: Junyu Xiong, Yonghui Wang, Rongjian Gu, Chenyu Liu, Bing Yin, Wengang Zhou, Houqiang Li
papers.affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China; iFLYTEK Research
papers.intro: 本文提出HIEVI-RAG，一个分层证据驱动的多模态检索增强生成框架，通过层次化问题分解、粗检索、EVIAGENT跨页证据验证和记忆引导的迭代生成，显著提升长文档问答准确率，平均超过现有最强基线8.05%。

papers.title: QSVideo: Query-Conditioned Semantic Temporal Retrieval for Video Understanding
papers.authors: Wei Ao, Lan Wang, Vishnu Naresh Boddeti
papers.affiliations: Michigan State University（密歇根州立大学）
papers.intro: QSVideo提出了一种查询条件语义时间检索框架，通过将任意问题转化为检索友好的查询、沿物体/动作/位置三个语义维度估计结构化相关性，并联合优化相关性、多样性和时间覆盖度，在严格帧预算下大幅提升长视频与流式视频的VLM理解性能。

papers.title: EgoInertia-MI: A Multimodal Egocentric Vision and IMU Benchmark for Motor Impairment Assessment
papers.authors: Fatemah Alhamdoosh, Pietro Pala, Abduallah Mohamed, DK Arvind
papers.affiliations: University of Florence, Italy; Meta Reality Labs, USA; University of Edinburgh, UK
papers.intro: 本文提出了EgoInertia-MI，一个同步采集第一人称视频和穿戴式IMU信号的多模态基准数据集，并定义了运动障碍严重程度估计与动作识别两个任务，验证了多模态融合在运动障碍评估中的优越性。

papers.title: Latent Clarity: Bridging World-Model Kinematics to Semantic Manifolds for Video Anomaly Anticipation
papers.authors: Abu Anas Ibn Samad
papers.affiliations: Sigmind.ai, Dhaka 1215, Bangladesh
papers.intro: 本文提出PULS框架，通过一个490M参数的KSD桥接器将V-JEPA 2的预测运动学表征映射到Qwen3-VL语义超球面，并辅以一个轻量级ASP模块锐化未来表征，实现了无需MIL的高AUROC视频异常检测和+9.6pp零样本VQA精度提升，验证了“潜在清晰性假设”。

papers.title: Modality Relevance is not Modality Utility: Post-hoc Selective Modality Escalation for Cost-Aware Multimodal RAG
papers.authors: Xue Li, Yiming Gai
papers.affiliations: Hangzhou International Innovation Institute, Beihang University, Hangzhou, China
papers.intro: 本文提出“后验选择性模态升级”：先基于廉价文本+表格上下文生成草稿答案，再用验证器定位缺失的模态（特别是图像），最后由校准的价值升级路由器按预期准确率增益与成本阈值决定是否调用VLM，从而以远低于全时VLM的视觉调用率恢复其准确率，并逼近模态oracle。

papers.title: A Multi-Task Deep Learning Framework for Real-Time Intelligent Video Surveillance with Temporal Event Validation
papers.authors: Estera Dumitru, Stelian Spînu
papers.affiliations: Military Technical Academy “Ferdinand I”, Bucharest, Romania
papers.intro: 本文构建了一个基于共享GPU的、可实时运行的多任务深度学习视频监控框架，在统一架构中并行执行人脸识别、车牌识别、武器检测、烟火检测和人体动作识别，并通过时序事件验证机制将帧级预测转化为可靠的安全事件，显著降低了误报率并提升了识别准确率。
